findings.en_sentence: In 2013, Alexander Kellner referred specimen MN 6594-1, a nearly complete skeleton, to Tropeognathus, a conclusion later supported by Taissa Rodrigues and Kellner.
findings.es_sentence: En 2013, Alexander Kellner refirió el ejemplar MN 6594-1, un esqueleto casi completo, a Tropeognathus, una conclusión posteriormente apoyada por Taissa Rodrigues y Kellner.
findings.problem: Rodrigues & Kellner (2013) concluded that the genus Tropeognathus is valid; they did not 'later support' Kellner's referral of MN 6594-V, and both works are from 2013.
findings.correct: In 2013 Kellner and colleagues referred a large, fairly complete skeleton (MN 6594-V) to Tropeognathus cf. T. mesembrinus; the same year Rodrigues and Kellner confirmed Tropeognathus as a valid genus.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Discovery and naming; F007, F018, F033

findings.en_sentence: In 2013, Alexander Kellner referred specimen MN 6594-1, a nearly complete skeleton, to Tropeognathus, a conclusion later supported by Taissa Rodrigues and Kellner.
findings.es_sentence: En 2013, Alexander Kellner refirió el ejemplar MN 6594-1, un esqueleto casi completo, a Tropeognathus, una conclusión posteriormente apoyada por Taissa Rodrigues y Kellner.
findings.problem: The specimen number is MN 6594-V (as the page's sources state elsewhere); 'MN 6594-1' is a typo copied from the wiki text.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Size and Cultural significance (MN 6594-V); Kellner et al. 2013

findings.en_sentence: The genus belongs to the family Ornithocheiridae, also known as Anhangueridae, and was a close relative of the species in the genus Anhanguera.
findings.problem: Ornithocheiridae and Anhangueridae are not synonyms; this sentence (from eswiki intro) contradicts sentences 13-14, which present them as rival family placements. Also repeats the classification paragraph.
findings.correct: Drop the sentence, or say only that Tropeognathus was a close relative of Anhanguera.
findings.checked_in: enwiki intro and Classification; eswiki intro; F022

findings.en_sentence: Later scientific analysis revised the maximum estimated wingspan of the large specimen used in media to 8.70 meters, identifying it as the largest known individual pterosaur based on its completeness.
findings.es_sentence: Un análisis científico posterior revisó la envergadura alar máxima estimada del gran ejemplar utilizado en los medios a 8,70 metros, identificándolo como el pterosaurio individual más grande conocido basándose en su completitud.
findings.problem: Overstated: the source says MN 6594-V was, for its degree of completeness, the largest known pterosaur individual (i.e. largest among relatively complete specimens), not the largest known pterosaur; also 'revised' is not in the source.
findings.correct: The 2013 description estimated a maximum wingspan of 8.70 m for MN 6594-V, the largest relatively complete pterosaur individual known at the time.

findings.en_sentence: Later scientific analysis revised the maximum estimated wingspan of the large specimen used in media to 8.70 meters, identifying it as the largest known individual pterosaur based on its completeness.
findings.es_sentence: Un análisis científico posterior revisó la envergadura alar máxima estimada del gran ejemplar utilizado en los medios a 8,70 metros, identificándolo como el pterosaurio individual más grande conocido basándose en su completitud.
findings.problem: 'The large specimen used in media' refers to the Walking with Dinosaurs episode, which the page never introduces.
findings.correct: Mention the BBC Walking with Dinosaurs size claim, or just name the specimen MN 6594-V.

findings.en_sentence: The species Tropeognathus mesembrinus could have reached a wingspan of around 8.2 meters.
findings.es_sentence: La especie Tropeognathus mesembrinus podría haber alcanzado una envergadura alar de unos 8,2 metros.
findings.problem: Third different wingspan figure (8.5 m, 8.70 m, 8.2 m) given without explaining which is the typical estimate and which the maximum.
findings.correct: Kellner et al. 2013 estimated about 8.26 m for MN 6594-V, with a maximum of 8.70 m; give these together.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Size; eswiki Descripción; F010, F011, F025

findings.en_sentence: The presence of convex, keeled crests on the snout and a mass on the lower jaw suggests these features played a role in the animal's display or social interactions.
findings.es_sentence: La presencia de crestas convexas y con quilla en el hocico y una masa en la mandíbula inferior sugiere que estas características jugaron un papel en los comportamientos de exhibición o las interacciones sociales del animal.
findings.problem: Invented interpretation: neither source nor cited facts attribute a display/social function to the crests; Wellnhofer originally proposed a hydrodynamic stabilizing role and crest function remains debated.
findings.correct: Remove, or say the function of the crests is uncertain (proposed roles include display and stabilization while feeding at the water surface).
findings.checked_in: enwiki Skull and crests; F012, F026; knowledge

findings.en_sentence: Fossils were found in the Romualdo Formation within the Santana Group in northeastern Brazil, specifically in the Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation.
findings.es_sentence: Los fósiles se encontraron en la Formación Romualdo, dentro del Grupo Santana, en el noreste de Brasil, específicamente en el Miembro Romualdo de la Formación Santana.
findings.problem: Mixes two stratigraphic schemes as if they were different places: 'Romualdo Formation within the Santana Group' and 'Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation' are alternative names for the same unit.
findings.correct: Fossils come from the Romualdo Formation (formerly treated as the Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation), Santana Group, Araripe Basin, northeastern Brazil.
findings.checked_in: enwiki intro/Discovery; eswiki Clasificación; F004, F031

findings.en_sentence: Recent analyses in 2019 and 2020 place Tropeognathus in the subfamily Tropeognathinae within Anhangueridae, as a sister taxon to Siroccopteryx.
findings.es_sentence: Análisis recientes de 2019 y 2020 sitúan a Tropeognathus en la subfamilia Tropeognathinae dentro de la Anhangueridae, como taxón hermano de Siroccopteryx.
findings.problem: Overgeneralized: only Holgado & Pêgas (2020), who named Tropeognathinae, placed it there as sister to Siroccopteryx; the 2019-2020 analyses in general only recovered it in Anhangueridae.
findings.correct: Analyses from 2019-2020 recover Tropeognathus in Anhangueridae; Holgado and Pêgas (2020) placed it in the subfamily Tropeognathinae, as sister taxon to Siroccopteryx.

findings.es_sentence: Su columna vertebral presentaba fusiones especializadas para la estabilidad: las cinco primeras vértebras dorsales se unían en una estructura llamada notarium, mientras que cinco vértebras sacras se fusionaban en un sínfisisacro.
findings.problem: 'sínfisisacro' is not a word; the Spanish term is 'sinsacro' (as in the eswiki source).
findings.correct: ...cinco vértebras sacras se fusionaban en un sinsacro.

findings.en_sentence: Fossils of Tropeognathus date to the Early Cretaceous period, specifically the Albian stage, when the animal lived in South America during the late Early Cretaceous.
findings.problem: The Spanish page omits the age sentence (Early Cretaceous, Albian); the Spanish text never states when the animal lived.
findings.correct: Add: 'Los fósiles de Tropeognathus datan del Cretácico Inferior, concretamente del Albiense.'
findings.checked_in: texts en vs es; F002, F003

findings.en_sentence: Wellnhofer also named a second species, Tropeognathus robustus, in 1987.
findings.es_sentence: Wellnhofer también nombró una segunda especie, Tropeognathus robustus, en 1987.
findings.problem: Introduces T. robustus as a second species without saying it is no longer part of the genus (now Anhanguera robustus), which conflicts with sentence 17 ('only the species T. mesembrinus').
findings.correct: Add that T. robustus was later moved to Anhanguera (Rodrigues & Kellner 2013).
findings.checked_in: enwiki Discovery and naming; eswiki Clasificación

findings.en_sentence: Its spine featured specialized fusions for stability: the first five dorsal vertebrae were joined into a structure called a notarium, while five sacral vertebrae were fused into a synsacrum.
findings.es_sentence: Su columna vertebral presentaba fusiones especializadas para la estabilidad: las cinco primeras vértebras dorsales se unían en una estructura llamada notarium, mientras que cinco vértebras sacras se fusionaban en un sínfisisacro.
findings.problem: 'Specialized fusions for stability' adds a purpose not in the source, which only describes the fusions.
findings.correct: Its first five dorsal vertebrae were fused into a notarium, and five sacral vertebrae into a synsacrum.

findings.es_sentence: El nombre del género Tropeognathus proviene de las palabras griegas para quilla y mandíbula, mientras que el nombre de la especie mesembrinus deriva del griego para 'desde el sur', haciendo referencia a su origen en el hemisferio sur.
findings.problem: Calques: 'palabras griegas para quilla' and 'del griego para "desde el sur"'; mesembrinos means 'del sur, del mediodía', not 'desde'.
findings.correct: ...proviene de las palabras griegas que significan «quilla» y «mandíbula», y mesembrinus del griego «del sur», en referencia a su procedencia del hemisferio sur.

findings.es_sentence: Un análisis científico posterior revisó la envergadura alar máxima estimada del gran ejemplar utilizado en los medios a 8,70 metros, identificándolo como el pterosaurio individual más grande conocido basándose en su completitud.
findings.problem: Calques 'utilizado en los medios' and 'basándose en su completitud' (from 'based on its completeness').
findings.correct: ...el gran ejemplar mostrado en televisión... el pterosaurio relativamente completo más grande conocido.

findings.es_sentence: Tropeognathus se clasifica dentro de la familia Anhangueridae, aunque algunos estudios lo sitúan en la Ornithocheiridae, creando un debate sobre la clasificación familiar con algunos investigadores europeos que prefieren esta última.
findings.problem: 'clasificación familiar' calques 'family classification' (familiar = doméstico/conocido); also 'la Ornithocheiridae' with article.
findings.correct: ...un debate sobre su clasificación a nivel de familia, y algunos investigadores europeos prefieren Ornithocheiridae.

findings.en_sentence: Tropeognathus is considered the largest pterosaur found in the Southern Hemisphere, with an estimated wingspan of about 8.5 meters.
findings.es_sentence: Tropeognathus se considera el pterosaurio más grande encontrado en el hemisferio sur, con una envergadura alar estimada de unos 8,5 metros.
findings.problem: 'Largest pterosaur found in the Southern Hemisphere' omits the source's caveat 'only rivaled by the huge azhdarchids' (e.g. Argentina's Thanatosdrakon, ~7-9 m).
findings.correct: Tropeognathus is among the largest pterosaurs from the Southern Hemisphere, rivaled only by large azhdarchids.
